messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 — Praxis (dedicated VPC pool) experiencing sustained tail-latency and queue pileup on scheduler. Erroring requests and abandoned batches. Paging eng-oncall. https://redwood.internal/inc/2412345678 :rotating_light:
maria: ACKed. Seeing spike in queue depth for Praxis-worker-3g. 95th latency to token generation is 6s and growing. Root cause not obvious yet. Pulling scheduler metrics now.
ryan: I'm jumping in — can anyone confirm whether Praxis has any recent config changes? Any rollout in the past 2 hours?
maria: No config rollouts flagged. Their usage pattern changed — many small rapidly-sequenced prompts from the same tenant (bursting chat UI). Looks like too many tiny batches getting scheduled; max_batch_tokens currently set to 8192 for their bespoke pool.
ashley: tagging @samir for batching knob expertise. If we reduce max_batch_tokens we can bound batch formation time, but might increase per-token cost.
samir: on it. From logs: continuous batching window for Praxis-worker-* is stretching to 250ms because token counts per request are tiny and scheduler waits to fill token budget. That explains tail latency. Propose temporarily lowering max_batch_tokens and enabling queue-gating for that tenant only.
maria: Agreed. Recommend quick mitigation: set max_batch_tokens: 2048 and enable tenant_queue_gating: true (rejecting low-priority background requests).
ryan: How do we do that safely in Dedicated? Can we patch the tenant config without a full rollout?
samir: Yes — we have tenant-level runtime overrides for dedicated pools. Applying via admin API: ```
POST /admin/tenants/praxis/overrides
{
  "scheduler": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 2048,
    "batch_window_ms": 20,
    "queue_gating": {"enabled": true, "priority_threshold": 30}
  }
}
```
maria: I'll stage the override to Praxis-canary first (worker-3g-canary). If canary looks good for 2 minutes, we'll push to the rest.
opsbot: deploy-bot: Starting staged override to Praxis-canary on pool praxis-dedicated-3g-canary (job id: dj-7791). Watch logs: /ops/logs/praxis/dj-7791
ryan: Observability note — add a temporary dashboard showing per-tenant batch formation latency and median batch size. I'm adding charts now.
ashley: Can we also throttle their frontend burst at the ingress layer? We can apply a short token-rate limit per-IP to blunt the burst while config changes propagate.
samir: Good idea. Maria, can you coordinate ingress throttle with infra? Suggested rule: 200 req/min with 10req/sec burst allowed for tenant Praxis for 10 minutes.
maria: Infra team pinged. Applying ingress rate limit rule now.
opsbot: infra-bot: Applied rate limit for tenant Praxis: 200rpm (burst 10rps) — rule id rl-4312.
maria: Canary patch shows batch-formation latency drop from 250ms -> 30ms and 95p token gen latency down to ~600ms. No obvious errors. Rolling override to full Praxis pool in 30s.
ryan: Nice. Keep monitoring error-rate and queue depth. If we see client-visible errors, rollback immediately.
samir: Rolling to full pool now. Command: `adminctl tenant apply-overrides praxis --from dj-7791`
opsbot: deploy-bot: Override applied to praxis-dedicated-* pools (job id dj-7791).
maria: Post-rollout metrics: batch size median decreased from 48 tokens to 12 tokens (expected), batch-formation latency stable ~25-35ms. Tail latency improved. CPU on workers increased ~7% but within capacity.
ashley: Customer impact assessment? Any dropped requests or API error spikes?
maria: No increase in 5xx. A few marginal 429s at the ingress during the first 30s of throttle churn while clients retried — small blips, cleared. Notifying account team: @amanda-account.
ryan: Let's leave these overrides for 2 hours and then evaluate whether we need a longer-term schedule rule for Praxis or a config-based traffic shaping. Also add an action item to run a load-profile test with Praxis workload shape in staging.
samir: Filed follow-up ticket: ENG-5691 — 'Praxis: analyze sustained small-request workload; recommend batching profile or SDK guidance'.
maria: Handoff to next oncall: @ryan, I'll include notes in the incident channel and mark for 2-hour watch.
ryan: Got it. I'll take the watch. If anything regresses, call the oncall pager. Great work team. :thumbsup:
opsbot: incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) — praxis queue pileup mitigated via tenant overrides and ingress throttling. Monitoring for 2h. incident id INC-2412345678
